files.column.name: Name
files.delete.confirm: Delete {name} from the workspace? Bots and people can no longer open it, and chat messages that attached it keep only its name.
files.detail.checkedNote: Deskmates keeps no snapshot: preview and download read the current bytes, which may differ from the checked version.
files.detail.currentBytes: Preview and download read the file as it is now. A delivery reference does not guarantee these are the bytes that were delivered.
files.detail.inputNote: A file a person attached as input; not a bot result.
files.detail.label: Details for {name}
files.detail.lastReferencedNote: When a chat or task last referenced this path, not when the file changed.
files.detail.previewUnsupported: Office documents and unsupported formats are download-only in this version.
files.detail.publishedFromDeleted: Published from {kind} of task {title} (task deleted; publication kept)
files.detail.replaced: {count} earlier version(s) of this task's file were replaced.
files.detail.sizeUnknown: Known after a preview or download reads the file
files.detail.unknownSource: No reference ties this file to a bot run. Who wrote it is unknown.
files.detail.unverifiedNote: Recorded before server verification existed. Its existence and version were never checked.
files.empty.body: A file appears here when a bot names a /work or /home path in a chat, attaches a file, or delivers a task. Uploading files is not available yet.
files.empty.title: No referenced files yet
files.emptyFiltered.body: Try another type, source or search.
files.emptyFiltered.bodyWithFilters: No files match: {filters}. Try changing or clearing these filters.
files.emptyFiltered.title: No matching files
files.intro: Files that bots and people referenced in this workspace’s chats and tasks.
files.noWorkspace: Create a workspace to see its files.
files.read.missing: No file exists at this path now. Its references are kept.
files.read.notRunning: The workspace is not running, so the file cannot be read now. Browsing Files never starts it; it starts when a bot runs. Try again then.
files.read.tooLarge: The file is larger than the download limit.
files.scope: Files lists formally delivered bot results the server verified, files people attached as input, and older deliveries marked unverified. Drafts and paths mentioned in chat stay in their chat.
files.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, path or label
files.source.unknownTitle: No reference ties this file to a bot run
files.title: Files
files.truncated: Only the newest {limit, number} references of each kind were read. Older references are not listed.

files.upload.notRunning: The workspace is not running. Start it, then retry.
files.upload.quota: This upload would exceed the workspace's upload quota.
files.upload.storageFull: The workspace disk is full. Free space, then retry; the upload resumes where it stopped.
files.uploadedEmpty: No file has been uploaded or attached by a person yet.

workspaceFilePreview.pageInvalid: Enter a page number from 1 to {pages}.
